entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • 'Diagnostic analyzer runner' crashing #80964
  • [Obsolete(error: true)] ignored in code marked `[Obsolete]` #80961

Closed

  • API reference is still 4.13 #80917
  • Consider special-casing Interlocked.Exchange and friends for nullable inference #51191
    Backlog
  • Source generators: projectreference #60964
  • C# null-coalescing operators (??=) - silently fail on dictionary #80953
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11129.33 #80956

    Area-Compilers
  • Fix parsing of delegate declarations with tuple return types at top-level #80889
